title: B10: Verify (and fix if needed) StepsView multi-section rendering
description: After B1 and B2 land, the parser emits 3 sections for the Pasta Bolognese fixture. Verify that the existing StepsView.swift already renders section headers with per-section step numbering per its 0004 AC. If it does: document in the bead handoff that no code change was needed. If it does NOT: apply the minimal fix to StepsView.swift so each section name appears as a header and step numbering restarts at 1 per section. Document which case applied.

handoff_summary.remaining: None — this bead is fully resolved. Upstream fixture/parser beads (B-bf21ece4, B-27028c1c, B-9a46d66c) are responsible for ensuring the parser emits the correct section names from the Pasta Bolognese fixture.
handoff_summary.next_action: Proceed to tester agent to verify multi-section rendering with the Pasta Bolognese fixture end-to-end.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: No changes were needed. StepsView.swift was already compliant with spec 0004 AC for the Steps tab: RecipeSectionStepsView renders a SwiftUI Section with an optional header (showing section.name when non-nil) and its `rows` computed property resets `stepNumber = 1` locally, so numbering restarts per section.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No new tests needed. Existing behavior already matches the spec. Tester should verify end-to-end with the Pasta Bolognese fixture once upstream parser beads have landed.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: AC #1 names ('Getting the meat browned', 'Preparing the sofrito', 'Finishing the sauce and cooking the pasta') do not match the current fixture's section names ('Soffritto', 'Meat Sauce', 'Pasta'). This is an upstream concern for the parser/fixture beads, not StepsView.

execution_history.summary: No code change required. StepsView.swift already correctly implements multi-section rendering: section headers are shown via `if let name = section.name { Text(name).font(.headline) }` and step numbering restarts at 1 per section because `var stepNumber = 1` is local to each `RecipeSectionStepsView` instance.
